items.title: Tommy Newsom and Ross Tompkins interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, September 3, 1995

ctx.x: Well Benny was very weird with drummers. I don’t think he liked any drummers after Gene Krupa. And he didn’t like Gene Krupa.
Ed told us a story, maybe he’ll tell you if you ask him about it, how he handled Benny. And it was pretty good. I don’t know if I should go through it now but—
